name: Accessibility Interpreter & Subtitles
description: DVB-I/HbbTV prototype: flexible sign-language interpreter overlay and subtitles for deaf and hard-of-hearing viewers.
typeDescription: Linked application with media in parallel (red-button style); launches when service is selected.
author: Master's thesis prototype
features: Dual video: main content + interpreter overlay

dvb-i.notes: Type 1.1 = app with media in parallel. Type 1.2 = app controlling media. Serve this app at the base URL; DVB-I service list references the base URL or this manifest URL.
dvb-i.testing: Linked from DVB-I Reference Client as Thesis accessibility list (thesis.xml). Channel 1 = Accessibility demo channel; main stream in DVB-I client, this app = interpreter overlay. Run backend: node scripts/start-dvbi-reference-client.js; run app: python3 -m http.server 8080 from HbbTV. See docs/WHAT_NOW_DVBI_BACKEND.md and docs/BACKEND_SETUP.md.
